query: Consider Media News Group, Inc.'s Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document allow the Receiving Party to share some Confidential Information with third parties, including consultants, agents, and professional advisors?
gold:
1. The term “Confidential Information” shall mean any confidential, proprietary, financial or otherwise non-public information, in written or electronic form, relating to the Disclosing Party, or the Purpose that is disclosed before, on or after the Effective Date, by the Disclosing Party to the Recipient or its affiliates, or to any of such Recipient’s or its affiliates’ employees, officers, directors, partners, shareholders, agents, attorneys, accountants or advisors (collectively, “Representatives”), whether disclosed or accessed in written, electronic or other form, including, without limitation:
3. Recipient shall not, and shall cause its Representatives not to, (a) disclose all or any portion of Confidential Information to any third parties (other than to its Representatives who need to know the Confidential Information to assist Recipient in its evaluation of the Purpose), or
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, Disclosing Party acknowledges and agrees that (a) the Recipient is expressly authorized to disclose the Confidential Information to certain lenders and investors, in furtherance of Recipient’s performance of its obligations with respect to the Purpose and (b) under no circumstances will Recipient have any liability for any disclosure by such lenders or investors of any of the Confidential Information.
4. Except as otherwise provided in this Agreement, without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party, Recipient shall not disclose to any person or entity (other than its Representatives who are involved in its evaluation of the Purpose) any information with respect to the occurrence or content of any discussions or negotiations between the Parties.
rag_answer:
Yes, but only in a limited way.

Under the Media News Group, Inc. NDA, the Receiving Party/Recipient may not disclose Confidential Information to third parties generally, except to its “Representatives” who need to know the information to assist in evaluating the Purpose. The Agreement defines Representatives to include employees, officers, directors, partners, shareholders, agents, attorneys, accountants, or advisors.

So the document allows sharing Confidential Information with agents and professional advisors, provided they are Representatives and have a need to know for the investment/financing evaluation. Consultants are not expressly listed, so they would only be permitted if they qualify as “advisors” or another category of Representative.

The Agreement also expressly permits disclosure to certain lenders and investors, and permits disclosure where required by law, subpoena, court order, or regulatory demand. The Recipient remains responsible for any breach by its Representatives.

judge.gold_summary: NDA 允许接收方在有限条件下向第三方披露保密信息：可向其 Representatives（包括 agents、attorneys、accountants、advisors 等）披露，前提是其需要知悉以协助评估 Purpose；并明确允许向 certain lenders and investors 披露。consultants 未被明确列举，但可能作为 advisors 或其他 Representatives 被覆盖。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出允许有限共享，接收方可向 Representatives 披露，Representatives 包括 agents、advisors 等；agents 和 professional advisors 可在 need-to-know 条件下共享；consultants 未明确列出，但若属于 advisors/Representatives 则可；同时提到明确允许向 certain lenders and investors 披露。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键要点，包括允许向 Representatives（含 agents 和 advisors）有限披露、need-to-know 限制，以及向 certain lenders and investors 的明确授权；对 consultants 的处理也与金标一致，即未明确列举但可能属于 advisors。额外信息不构成矛盾。
